subject: Quick product showcase — pick a time pair for a 30m intro
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@horizoncare.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@horizoncare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick product showcase — pick a time pair for a 30m intro

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great context on your batch summarization use case and the latency/cost sensitivity you mentioned. To keep momentum, we recommend a focused 30‑minute showcase where we: (1) walk the product UI for your quick wins, (2) show a short live inference demo on near-real data, and (3) align success criteria + next steps.

Can you pick one of the two paired time windows below (we're in PDT):

Option A (earlier this week):
- Tue Sep 22 — 10:00–10:30 AM PDT OR 11:00–11:30 AM PDT (choose one)

Option B (later this week):
- Thu Sep 24 — 2:30–3:00 PM PDT OR 4:00–4:30 PM PDT (choose one)

If you prefer a different day, send 2 slots and we’ll adapt. For the session we suggest the following attendees: one product owner from your side (to confirm acceptance criteria) and your tech lead (to validate integration points). I’ve looped in Karthik (SE) to demo the integration/infra details.

I attached a short 30m agenda and a one-page mutual action plan so everyone is aligned.

Attachments: [30m-showcase-agenda.pdf (PDF), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel)]

Next steps: pick the preferred paired window + confirm who will join from your side (PO, Tech Lead).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192
[www.redwoodinference.com]
From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@horizoncare.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@horizoncare.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick product showcase — pick a time pair for a 30m intro

Thanks Irene — appreciate the recap and clear options.

Option B works better for our team. Can we lock Thu Sep 24, 2:30–3:00 PM PDT? That gives our engineering manager time to join.

Please also invite our security lead (Priya Rao <priya.rao@horizoncare.com>) — she’ll have a couple of quick SOC2 and data residency questions. Procurement might also join briefly (procurement@horizoncare.com) to start the contracting thread.

Does Redwood have a concise compliance pack or SOC2 attestations you can share ahead of the call? If possible, add a link or attach the security one-pager.

Looking forward to the demo.

— Samantha Jones
Director of Data Science, HorizonCare
samantha.jones@horizoncare.com | (206) 555-0124

Perfect — Thu Sep 24, 2:30–3:00 PM PDT is locked on our side. I’ll send a calendar invite (Google Meet) in a follow-up and include the security one-pager.

Karthik — can you join the demo and be prepared to cover integration touchpoints (API auth, batch vs. streaming recommendation, and an example of our prefix/KV caching)? If useful, bring a short slide on quantization options for cost savings (5 slides max).

Samantha / Priya / Tom — attached is the agenda and the mutual action plan. I’ve also added the SOC2 one-pager here: https://redwood-infra-docs.internal/soc2-onepager (internal link — we will send a sanitized external PDF before the meeting).

Attachments: [30m-showcase-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx]

See you all on Thu — calendar invite to follow.
